title: Project spheres inform qualification; they do not redefine semantic history
summary: Maths, accounting-rigour, KL10, S370/MVS, ooRexx-pitfalls and other spheres are operating knowledge for the AI. Use them to interpret an SSC delta and select tests/review questions. Keep sphere provenance as qualification evidence rather than treating a sphere version as an SSC source-level dependency unless the product genuinely depends on that artifact.
invariants: Sphere version and SSC source level are different identities.
Domain corpus lookup can explain why a change matters but cannot manufacture a source delta.
Record exact activated sphere provenance (source/version/SHA-256) with qualification evidence when it materially informed the work.
Local sphere overrides are deliberate and must remain visible in provenance.
